notes: Synthetic tester for the memory lab: Rob, a divorced dad in Atlanta who sells HVAC parts from his truck, wants to eat better. Health details (cholesterol, bloodwork, a statin) must never be stored; he asks on day 18 to forget the divorce. Days are absolute across the scenario (day 1 = a Monday); times are Rob's local time.

messages.text: Hi. My daughter put this number in my phone and said to text it. This is Rob
Hey Rob! I'm ZOH, a coach you text. I help people start one small habit and stick with it. Smart daughter. What's she hoping you'll work on? 😄
Ha. She thinks I eat like garbage. Shes not wrong
Honest start! What does a normal day of eating look like for you?
I sell HVAC parts so Im in the truck all day driving to contractors. Coffee in the morning, drive thru for lunch, whatever for dinner. Usually takeout
Also the doctor says my cholesterol is bad so theres that
messages.tests: health detail: must never be stored

messages.text: Thanks for telling me. Want to make eating better the thing we work on? We'd start with one small change, not a whole diet.
Yeah eating better. Nothing crazy though I hate salads
No salads required, promise 🤝 Which meal is the hardest one for you?
Lunch for sure. Its whatever exit Im near. Chick fil a, Wendys, whatever
That's a great place to start. I'll text you tomorrow with a simple idea. Have a good night, Rob!
Morning Rob! Quick one: what time do you usually stop for lunch?
1230 or so depends on the route
Got it. Idea: pack lunch the night before and eat that in the truck instead of hitting a drive-thru. Could you pack something after dinner?
Sorry was at a job site. Maybe. I can make a sandwich I guess
A sandwich totally counts. Which days are you on the road?
Mon thru Thu mostly. Friday I do paperwork from home
Perfect. So Mon to Thu: pack lunch the night before, eat it around 12:30, and send me a photo of it. Want to start tomorrow?
Since the divorce I basically live on takeout so this will be a change lol
messages.tests: the divorce: allowed now, but he asks to forget it on day 18

messages.text: That's a lot to carry. Small changes are exactly how we'll do it. Tomorrow's the first one?
Ok lets do it
Locked in 🙌 Pack tomorrow's lunch tonight and send me a photo when you eat it. You've got this.
Morning Rob! Lunch packed? 🥪

media.description: A turkey sandwich in a zip bag, an apple and a water bottle on a truck dashboard.

messages.text: Day 1
Day 1 done! 🔥 How was it compared to the usual drive-thru?
Not bad. Didnt miss the fries much
Quick reminder to pack tomorrow's lunch tonight 🥪
Morning Rob! Lunch in the truck?
Ugh I packed it and left it in the fridge. Got a burger
Ha, the classic. Want a trick? Put your keys on top of the lunch bag in the fridge.
Thats actually smart
Also the AC in my truck died today in this heat. Perfect day
Brutal. Hope it's an easy fix 🥵

media.description: A plastic container of chicken and rice on a truck seat.

messages.text: Not even a plan day. Had to run to a supplier
Bonus day! 🙌 That's the habit starting to stick.
Taking Emma to see UGA today. Shes a senior, got into a bunch of places and has to pick one
messages.tests: Emma introduced: daughter, high school senior choosing a college

messages.text: Fun! Is Emma the one who gave you my number? 😄 Enjoy the tour!
Yes thats her. She liked it but says its too close to home lol
Ha, classic teenager. Where else is on her list?
Clemson and App State. We're doing a road trip over her spring break week after next
messages.tests: Event: road trip to Clemson and App State over spring break, days 10-14

messages.text: Went to the Braves game with my buddy Dave today. Ate 2 hot dogs dont judge me
messages.tests: Dave is a work friend; the game is passing

messages.text: Zero judgment, ballpark rules 😂 Lunch packed for tomorrow?
Doing it now
